# MR-S10 P01 D102 R1.7 — ChatGPT Adam Instruction Files & Local Assistant

**Owner request:** Upload a file generated by ChatGPT Adam to the existing D102 laboratory, examine instructions, execute approved workflow actions while training, and preserve a source-backed assignment register for eventual ECRL full-corridor geometry.

**Reality / protection:** This is a **local interactive task orchestrator**, not an autonomous ChatGPT model in the PWA, not a GitHub agent, not survey-grade GIS and not a server-side background job. Production/P02/P03 unchanged. No commands run without an explicit Owner button click and a browser confirmation.

## Supported package
Save the JSON as `mr-s10-d102-adam-assignment.json` (plain UTF-8). Files .json and .txt containing JSON accepted, maximum 500KB. Do not import Javascript/Python, raw executable scripts, shell commands, SQL or arbitrary chat prompt text. A short template can be downloaded directly from the page.

```json
{
 "schema":"mrs10-d102-owner-directives-v1",
 "scope":"MR_S10_P01_D102_LAB",
 "assignmentId":"ADAM_STN01_PREDEPARTURE_01",
 "title":"ECRL STN01 rail geometry source audit and first movement",
 "originLabel":"ChatGPT Adam",
 "commands":[
  {"id":"A001","op":"SELECT_ASSET","payload":{"assetCode":"STN01"}},
  {"id":"A002","op":"RECORD_GEOMETRY_GAP","payload":{
    "assetCode":"STN01","CH":670,"source":"MR-S10 Owner accepted CH manifest",
    "description":"Accurate surveyed STN01 station centreline, turnout connectivity and platforms are not yet sourced."}},
  {"id":"A003","op":"ASSISTANT_ASSIGNMENT","payload":{
    "assetCode":"STN01","title":"Audit authorized STN01 geometry sources",
    "source":"MR-S10 railway source lineage ledger",
    "checklist":["Inspect lawful station railway drawing source, date and licence",
      "Match STN01 accepted CH000+670 to actual source geometry",
      "Identify platform and turnouts only when shown by source",
      "Flag remaining gaps without guessing latitude or longitude"]}},
  {"id":"A004","op":"QUEUE_CHECKPOINT","payload":{"assetCode":"STN02"}}
 ]
}
```

## Allowlisted directives
- `SELECT_ASSET`: show station/PL source and focus locality reference.
- `QUEUE_CHECKPOINT`: request the **existing D102 Owner popup** for the next accepted station/PL. Cannot bypass CH authority or advance the train.
- `IMPORT_LAYOUT_DRAFT`: show **source-based 0..100 schematic SVG** using explicit track polylines. Not a georeferenced as-built diagram and not public.
- `REGISTER_INFRA_CANDIDATE`: append sourced CH bridge/tunnel/QZ/turnout candidates, to be used by CH-only prompts. No invented CH or geometry.
- `RECORD_GEOMETRY_GAP`: record missing geometry evidence for the given CH/asset (no effect on physical alignment).
- `ADD_SOURCE_REFERENCE`: record source and what it potentially supports; publication remains prohibited until independently checked.
- `ASSISTANT_ASSIGNMENT`: append a source-backed checklist for railway system tasks, reviewed by Owner.

Every command requires a 3+ character unique `id`. Asset codes and CH must come from the 23 accepted ECRL registry checkpoints. Any supplied "survey verified", "public published", "live GPS" or "auto approve" claims are rejected. Explicit `script`, `sql`, `shell`, `eval`, `github`, `vercel`, `supabase` and privileged payload keys are rejected.

## User workflow
1. In the **MR-S10 Assistant · Arahan ChatGPT Adam** panel, choose the JSON file saved from the ChatGPT conversation.
2. Read the exact action list and its evidentiary status; loading a file by itself performs **zero actions**.
3. Press **Lulus & Jalankan** separately for a command (or **Langkau**). Confirm the browser dialog.
4. If the directive asks to queue a checkpoint, the pre-existing departure/arrival Owner popup must be completed. The direction must agree with the chosen D102 route. No direct live train location or remote dispatch.
5. Commands, their outcomes and task/source references persist in `localStorage` **only for the same browser and preview origin**. Export the JSON audit ledger and journey backup before changing domains.
6. A second conflicting assignment cannot overwrite a package with pending commands. Complete/export/review the first package before replacing it.

## Next engineering gates not solved by this module
- Secure Owner authentication and service-backed task ledger; current module is not secure cloud synchronization.
- Georeferenced authoritative ECRL vector geometry with source provenance and rights, station/PL turnout graph and matching CH linear referencing.
- Automated semantic extraction from PDF/jpg engineering plans after separate Owner-authorized, source-preserving review. Current picture importer displays images; it does not infer railway geometry.
- Background/asynchronous AI agent is **not included**; in-page status updates only while Preview is open.
- Model train movement remains **CH-only** until proper GIS vector and appropriate operator/Owner QA.
